WORK_RESEARCH.intent: Study complete food-comic works only to improve appetite, rhythm, restraint and readable six-panel pacing. Do not promote observations into hard gates without repeated evidence.

RADAR.intent: Choose a concrete menu/moment capable of sustaining six publishable sensory beats without procedural filler.

EDITORIAL.intent: Define the PROXY_EATER appetite arc and map exactly six publishable beats. Slot roles remain story-dependent.

STORYBOARD.intent: Plan one six-cell board with minimal food-state/action continuity while leaving camera, pose, expression and per-cell composition fluid.

ASSET_PRODUCTION.intent: Compatibility stage name only: for JIPBAP_V1 this means generate the single text-free six-panel master board with bound style references. It does not mean asset resolution, ASSET_GAP authoring, or deterministic PERSON/FOOD part composition.

COMPOSITION.intent: Deterministically extract the accepted board, fit six 4:5 BODY pages, assemble the separate cover, and apply editable lettering/inner-thought layers. Do not regenerate accepted art for layout-only defects.

QC.intent: Apply only the JIPBAP_V1 publish-blocking hard fails to the master board; treat non-blocking polish issues as soft score. Review the completed carousel once before export.
